## BootstrapInterval

A non-negative statistic with its bootstrap confidence interval, in the unit of the property that holds it. Either value, ci\_low and ci\_high are all present, or they are all absent and insufficient\_samples\_reason says why (too few samples for the percentile); never both. ci\_low &lt;= value &lt;= ci\_high is not expressible here and is a servtuner analyze self-check.

Type: [BootstrapInterval1](/reference/api/models/#bootstrapinterval1) or [BootstrapInterval2](/reference/api/models/#bootstrapinterval2)

## BootstrapInterval1

| Field                         | Type               | Required | Description                                                                 |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------ | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ci_high`                     | `number` or `null` | No       |                                                                             |
| `ci_low`                      | `number` or `null` | No       |                                                                             |
| `insufficient_samples_reason` | `string` or `null` | No       | Present when value and the bounds are omitted because samples is too small. |
| `samples`                     | `integer`          | Yes      | Observations the statistic was computed from. ≥ 0                           |
| `value`                       | `number`           | Yes      | ≥ 0                                                                         |

## ComparisonResource

Runs lined up by knob and by stage. Every list of values is in `runs` order. It aligns values and does not rank them: stages are matched by index, which only compares like with like when `ladders\_match`. Runs that have not been indexed (no analysis.json) are listed in `unindexed\_run\_ids`.

| Field               | Type                                                                 | Required | Description |
| ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `knobs`             | array of [KnobComparison](/reference/api/models/#knobcomparison)     | Yes      |             |
| `ladders_match`     | `boolean`                                                            | Yes      |             |
| `metrics`           | array of [MetricComparison](/reference/api/models/#metriccomparison) | Yes      |             |
| `runs`              | array of [RunResource](/reference/api/models/#runresource)           | Yes      |             |
| `unindexed_run_ids` | array of `string`                                                    | Yes      |             |

## CredentialInput

PUT /targets/{id}/credentials/{slot}: write-only. Exactly one form: - `value`: a key or token, which servtuner stores in a Secret it manages; - `username` and `password`: basic auth (the `admin` slot only); - `external`: a Secret you manage, by name.

| `username` | `string` or `null`                                                | No       | Default: `null`. |
| `value`    | `string` or `null`                                                | No       | Default: `null`. |

## UtcTimestamp

An RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC: a Z suffix, optional fractional seconds. The one timestamp representation used in every schema. Enforced by the pattern alone, with no format keyword, so every language checks it the same way.

Type: `string` (pattern `^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]\|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]\|[12][0-9]\|3[01])T([01][0-9]\|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:([0-5][0-9]\|60)(\.[0-9]+)?Z$`)
